paras: Cyrtodactylus jatnai, Jatna's bent-toed gecko, is a species of lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is endemic to Indonesia.
The specific name, jatnai is in honor of Indonesian conservationist Jatna Supriatna.
C. jatnai is found in western Bali, Indonesia.
C. jatnai may attain a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of about 6.5 cm (2.6 in).
The mode of reproduction of C. jatnai is unknown.
